correctness.rationale: A complete block-matrix computation proves the invariant density-matrix form for any induced leaf graph. The exact reduced 3-by-3 generator gives the claimed rational Laplace transform. Its cubic denominator is strictly Hurwitz for gamma>0 and k>=2; zero-frequency evaluation proves absolute convergence and the Green–Kubo formula. Positive second derivative on gamma>0 proves the unique optimizer. Distinct-root perturbation and residues prove the uniform fixed-theta large-k exponential law. Reproducible finite checks directly construct  full Lindblad superoperators from adjacency/Laplacian matrices and run 970 matrix/resolvent/optimizer/scaling comparisons; they corroborate rather than replace infinite proofs. Boundary k=1 is explicitly excluded.

value.rationale: The observable is the normalized zero-frequency stationary autocorrelation of a physically distinguished hub projector, a natural measurable integrated return-memory statistic. Its exact optimization exposes competition between small-gamma persistent coherent localization and large-gamma Zeno localization; arbitrary induced leaf edges drop out of the full density evolution, even absent leaf automorphisms. The sharp gamma proportional to degree and the uniform limiting exponential profile are structural predictions relevant to network-scale decoherence design. Its signed-integral nature and separation from mixing time are explicitly acknowledged; it is not offered as a routine reparametrization or a tiny finite example.
